people.name: Ai
people.line: A Canaanite city conquered by Joshua after initial defeat.

people.name: Joshua
people.line: Moses' assistant who led Israel into Canaan

translations.web: All the people who were in the city were called together to pursue after them. They pursued Joshua, and were drawn away from the city.
translations.bsb: Then all the men of Ai were summoned to pursue them, and they followed Joshua and were drawn away from the city.
translations.kjv: And all the people that were in Ai were called together to pursue after them: and they pursued after Joshua, and were drawn away from the city.
translations.asv: And all the people that were in the city were called together to pursue after them: and they pursued after Joshua, and were drawn away from the city.
